options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: bind_custom_options
options.description: Custom BIND options to include in the configuration file.

options.name: bind_dnssec_validation
options.description: Enable DNSSEC validation when BIND is acting as a recursive resolver.

options.name: bind_forwarder
options.description: Enable forwarding queries to other DNS servers listed below rather than this server performing its own recursion.

options.name: bind_forwarder_ips
options.description: The IP addresses of the DNS servers to forward queries to.

options.name: bind_global_settings
options.description: Global BIND settings to include in the configuration file.

options.name: bind_hide_version
options.description: Hide the BIND version in responses.

options.name: bind_ip_version
options.description: The IP version to use for the BIND service. Leave empty to use both IPv4 and IPv6.

options.name: bind_logging
options.description: Enable logging for the BIND service.

options.name: bind_notify
options.description: Notify slave server after any update on master.

options.name: bind_ram_limit
options.description: The maximum amount of RAM to use for the BIND service.

options.name: controlport
options.description: The TCP port to listen on for control requests (localhost only). Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: enable_bind
options.description: Enables the BIND service.

options.name: listenon
options.description: The interfaces to listen on for DNS requests.

options.name: listenport
options.description: The TCP and UDP port to listen on for DNS requests. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: log_only
options.description: When rate limiting, only log that the query limit has been exceeded. If disabled, the query will be dropped instead.

options.name: log_options
options.description: The categories to log.

options.name: log_severity
options.description: The minimum severity of events to log.

options.name: rate_enabled
options.description: Enable rate limiting for the BIND service.

options.name: rate_limit
options.description: The maximum number of queries per second to allow.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
